 4 banks revise fixed deposit interest rates in November: HDFC, ICICI, PNB, IOB; which offers the highest rate to senior citizens?
 Personal Finance News
 4 banks revise fixed deposit interest rates in November: HDFC, ICICI, PNB, IOB; which offers the highest rate to senior citizens?
 By Upstox News Desk 7 min read | Updated on November 12, 2026, 10:24 IST
 Preferred news source Select Upstox as your Preferred news source SUMMARY
 For senior citizens, the fixed deposit interest rate ceiling now ranges from 7.20% at HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank to 7.30% at PNB, where super senior citizens can earn 7.55%.
 Several banks have revised FD rates after RBI's repo rate hike last month. | Representational image/Shutterstock
 Weeks after the RBI repo rate hike in October 2026, at least four large banks have revised their fixed deposit interest rates for deposits below ₹3 crore this month. The FD rate revisions by these banks, however, point in mixed directions. 
 Open FREE Demat Account within minutes! Join now 
 While HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank have pushed up their long-tenure rates to a common 6.60% for general citizens, PNB has created a new 680-day bucket paying 6.80%, while Indian Overseas Bank has raised its 444-day rate but cut the 180-269 day tenure. 
 For senior citizens, the ceiling now ranges from 7.20% at HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank to 7.30% at PNB, where super senior citizens can earn 7.55%.

 5 things FD rate revisions convey
 First, the long end has converged. HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank both now pay 6.60% from three years all the way to 10 years to general citizens. So, stretching the tenure no longer earns a premium. HDFC Bank's 5-to-10-year rate has jumped 45 bps to 6.60%.
 Second, PNB's 680-day bucket at 6.80% is the highest general-citizen rate among the four banks, ahead of its own 444-day rate of 6.70% and IOB's 6.75%.
 Third, short-tenure gaps are wide. On a 46-90 day deposit, PNB pays 5.50% rate while HDFC Bank pays 4.25% and ICICI Bank 4.00%.
 Fourth, IOB has moved in the opposite direction: it raised the 444-day rate by 15 bps to 6.75% but cut 180-269 days from 4.75% to 4.50%. Its 121-179 day FD bucket still pays only 2.90%, less than its own 61-90 day rate.
 Fifth, for senior citizens the best in this set is PNB at 7.30%, with 7.55% for those above 80. HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank top out at 7.20% and IOB at 7.25%, or 7.50% for super seniors.
